entities.name: agg_messages_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'in') AS n_in, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND NOT coalesce(is_automated, false)) AS n_out, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND coalesce(is_automated, false)) AS n_auto FROM messages WHERE (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_channels
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(channel, '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_replies
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN coalesce(is_automated, false) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM m WHERE kind <> 'auto' ), turns AS ( SELECT t.order_id, t.occurred_at AS asked, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id AND r.kind = 'out' AND r.occurred_at > t.occurred_at) AS replied FROM manual t WHERE t.kind = 'in' AND (t.prev IS NULL OR t.prev = 'out') ) SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(replied) AS replies, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM replied - asked) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS median_hours, avg((replied - asked <= interval '1 hour')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_1h, avg((replied - asked <= interval '24 hours')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_24h FROM turns WHERE asked >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_messages_waiting
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN coalesce(is_automated, false) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM m WHERE kind <> 'auto' ), turns AS ( SELECT t.order_id, t.occurred_at AS asked, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id AND r.kind = 'out' AND r.occurred_at > t.occurred_at) AS replied FROM manual t WHERE t.kind = 'in' AND (t.prev IS NULL OR t.prev = 'out') ) SELECT o.order_no, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.asked) / 3600) AS hours FROM turns t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.replied IS NULL AND t.asked <= now() - interval '2 hours' AND t.asked >= now() - interval '30 days' AND o.stage NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND o.stage NOT IN ('Done', 'Delivered')

entities.name: agg_site_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_site_totals
entities.sql: SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_site_sources
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(site_source, ''), '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

entities.name: agg_site_devices
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(device, ''), '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 5

entities.name: agg_site_landings
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(landing_path, ''), '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 8
